$comment: Ground truth for Pragu Bench. Each entry names a rule and an element's testTag (exposed as its resource id through testTagsAsResourceId). 'barriers' must be reported; 'correctTwins' must not be. Rules not implemented yet are kept and skipped until they exist.

barriers.note: IconButton whose Icon has contentDescription = null
the Text beside the Switch is not connected to it; TalkBack says only "Off, Switch"
16 dp stars that touch: a touch inside a neighbour goes to the neighbour, so this star takes touches over 16 dp only. Compose reports touch areas that meet, which Pragu cannot split

correctTwins.note: toggleable Row: the Switch is named by the row's text
unnamed, but its state (Off) is exposed
28 sp at 3.2:1; large text needs 3:1, and Compose does not report text size
20 dp icon 2 dp from another; Compose enlarges its touch area well past 24 dp (checked on the emulator)
end star: it gains the free side's enlargement
end star: it gains the free side's enlargement

barriers.note: hideFromAccessibility(): Compose reports the node as not visible to the user, the same signal as off-screen content, so Pragu stays silent rather than guess. Its text stays readable but cannot be activated
clickable Box drawn as a checkbox
no role either: nothing in the tree says it is a checkbox, so a scan cannot tell it from a button. Seeing it needs a tap (crawler, M3)
clickable(role = Role.Checkbox): a checkbox role with no state
the "Promo code" text above is not connected to it; TalkBack says only "Edit box"
placeholder only: once someone types, it disappears from view and from the accessibility tree. A scan of the empty field cannot tell it from a label

correctTwins.note: toggleable Row: the Checkbox is named by the row's text
named by its text; only its state is missing
inactive components have no contrast requirement (WCAG 1.4.3)

barriers.note: one line only: at 200% an ellipsis hides the end

fixed-height box: at 200% the text is cut at its edges. Android keeps the positions of characters a box cuts off and grows large text far less than 2x, so Pragu cannot tell this from text that fits: a known miss

correctTwins.note: the same name, allowed to wrap
one line, but short enough to fit at 200%
box with a minimum height that grows
